title: Psalm 117: All Nations, Praise the LORD
summary: In two verses, the shortest psalm in the Psalter calls every nation and people to praise the LORD. The reason it gives is Israel's own experience: his loving devotion toward his people is great, and his faithfulness endures forever.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 117
from.text: The psalm has the shape of a complete hymn in miniature

line: The shortest psalm calls every nation to praise the LORD for his great loving devotion and his everlasting faithfulness.
guide: Learn it by heart in a minute. Then let it widen your picture of God's people: no nation is left out of its call, and none is above it.

stanzas.title: All nations and peoples, praise the LORD
For his loving devotion and faithfulness endure

verses.t: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
